directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

preserve: a contact sheet of a frame a second, 12 a sheet at 640 px (old sheets removed first), and transcript.txt a line per sentence with its mm:ss, from the working preview, into work-round-<n>/review-pack/<id>/
allowed_deltas: the sheets are made by tools/make-a-contact-sheet-of-pictures-or-video-frames frames_at_times.py and the words by tools/audio-transcription whisper_here where they were the film's own contact_sheet.py and whisper_words.py; the round is the option's (it was fixed to round 8); every_s, per_sheet, width, model and language are settings
banned_substitutions: a film's folders, option ids, watch-folder names or the person's name written into the code
a second copy of the overlay renderer (the overlay step calls tool:render-a-motion-graphics-overlay)
an edit of the person's graded project other than FilmCraft's own headless commands on a copy
